_readme: The history this browser holds for tests/history-count-export-agreement.test.js.
Static data, hand-counted. Nothing here is generated, and nothing here is derived
at test time from the code under test: the expected numbers below were counted by
reading these two arrays, so a test failure names the number that changed rather
than restating whatever the page happened to compute.
Six decisions and three releases, nine records in total. Owners are Ari (2),
Priya (2), Jules (2) among the decisions and Ari, Priya, Jules one each among the
releases. Every decision carries a status word the filter offers, and no record
is stored under the retired word 'approved' - the legacy mapping has its own
suite (tests/browsed-history-export-parity.test.js) and is not what these tests
count-d-cache is the record the field-completeness test reads: it shows context,
alternatives, owner, status, and two associated releases on one row.
Ids are prefixed 'count-' so they cannot collide with another suite's storage

decisions.title: Cache the read path
decisions.context: Read latency spikes under load; add a short-TTL cache in front of the hot query.
decisions.alternatives: Query tuning alone, which we had already tried twice.

decisions.title: Introduce feature flags
decisions.context: Decouple deploy from release so a bad rollout is a toggle, not a revert.

decisions.title: Adopt a durable job queue
decisions.context: Background work was lost on deploys; move to an at-least-once queue.

decisions.title: Shorten log retention
decisions.context: Log storage cost grew faster than traffic.

decisions.title: Move the scheduler off cron
decisions.context: Cron drift made the nightly report land at an unpredictable hour.
decisions.alternatives: Keep cron and widen the report's window.

decisions.title: Trace the checkout path
decisions.context: Nobody could say which hop spent the budget on a slow checkout.
decisions.alternatives: More log lines at the edges.

releases.title: Cache invalidation and flags
releases.description: Cache invalidation plus the first flagged rollout.
